title: Combat formation
description: A shape a multi-unit selection can be ordered into (GH-859, docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-28-combat-formations-design.md). A formation places CLASSES, not unit ids: the sim derives each unit's class from its JSON (`formationClassOf`, with the optional `formation_class` override in unit.schema.json) and fits the elements below to the ground in file order, each behind the last. Every number is an integer count of tiles, seconds or files; the sim converts once at load. `label` and `blurb` are i18n KEYS in packages/app/src/i18n/en.json, never text. P1a ships `files`, `rank`, `ring` and `point`; the `march`, `contact` radius and `on_call` fields are validated and compiled now so P1b changes no schema. `pnpm validate:data` (tools/validate_formations.mjs) holds the cross-file rules this schema cannot see: unique ids matching the filename, the i18n keys exist, `rest` only last and at most once, an ambush stance only with a ring and a spring drill, at most one ring.

id.description: Also the filename. Mirrors @lions/net FORMATION_ID, the wire pattern for a command's `formation` field.

blurb.description: i18n key of the one-line description.

factions.description: Who may order it. The sim knows sides, not factions: the rule is validateCommand's.

verb.description: Which armed order the formation rides on; `either` lets the armed verb decide.

min_members.description: Fewer placeable members than this and the order is today's plain order.

elements.description: Filled in this order, each behind the last.

march.description: P1b. Validated and compiled in P1a; the sim reads none of it yet.

classes.description: Formation classes this element takes. `rest` is every class no earlier element took; it may appear once, in the last element.

file_gap.description: Lateral tiles between files; unused with one file. Absent reads 1.

radius.description: [min, max] ring radius in tiles; the smallest radius that seats the members is used.

gap.description: Rows left empty between the previous element's rear and this one's front.

standoff.description: This element's front row is at least this many tiles behind the click (medics and aircraft hold back whatever is in front of them).

on_call.description: P1b. What this element does when the group calls.
